video.agency.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1第1行第7–8格（1.5–1.75秒）我开始胸前聚火，第2行第1–2格（2.0–2.25秒）前倾推出攻击，此时目标仍与我有明显距离，没有等到贴身才出手。第3–4行（4.0–7.75秒）我保持战斗姿态观察燃烧区域，第5行第4–8格（8.75–9.75秒）才逐渐站直，符合确认威胁解除后收势的动机。；[食尸鬼·claude] At 0.0–1.75s the three ghouls start at the right edge and run on all fours along the road toward her on the left, a little closer in each cell, and none of them stops to wait. At 2.0–2.25s they are still charging and the gap keeps shrinking. At 2.5–3.0s the fire-bird hits the lead ghoul, which knocks it over and sets it alight. At 3.25–3.75s the other two are swallowed one after another and catch fire where they stand. At 4.0–5.75s the burning bodies keep rolling and twisting on the road. By 6.0–7.0s they have dropped one at a time, and from 7.5s on only smoking bodies remain. From a ghoul's point of view the behavior makes sense: it charges with everything it has, gets hit, and reacts to it. Two things I could not confirm at the 4fps thumbnail size: the two rear ghouls skidding to a stop and raising their claws to cover their faces at about 2.6–2.8s, and the one that 'crawls a step toward her'. Neither shows up as idle waiting, though.

video.gaze.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1第1–4行（0–7.75秒）我的头部大体朝画右的目标区域，但人物面部过小，无法逐格确认视线是否跟随仍在活动的目标。第5行第6格至第6行第8格（9.25–11.75秒）站直后，也无法明确辨认我是在看右侧焦痕还是转向镜头；因此规格要求的全程目标注视及片尾看着整条焦痕均无法确认，按拿不准判fail。；[食尸鬼·claude] Not sure about this one. In the 4fps contact sheet the ghouls in the 0.0–2.25s charge are only a few pixels tall. From their posture they are clearly heading left toward her, but I can't make out which way their heads point or whether their eyes are on her, so I can't rule out a face turned toward the camera. In the 2.5–3.0s cells the two rear ghouls are blocked by the fire-bird and dust, so 'still glaring at her through the claw gaps' can't be confirmed either. At 4.0–5.75s, while they burn, it's also unclear whether the one ghoul that was supposed to look up and stare at her actually does. The spec requires them to face left toward her the whole time. These frames can't confirm that, so I'm marking it fail. The sections where they are burning or dead (3.6s onward, apart from that one ghoul) are exempt.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Watching it fresh, the clip reads clearly. 0:00–1:75: a fiery red figure stands on the left of the road while a pack of four-legged beasts (wolf/hyena-like) charges in from the right. 2:00: the figure fires a fire blast from its hand. 2:25–3:75: the blast turns into a fire phoenix that sweeps along the road into the pack, leaving a trail of black smoke. 4:00–6:75: the beasts are on fire and fall to the ground, burning across the road. 7:00–11:75: the fire goes out, leaving only smoking remains, and the figure stands alone and unhurt. So who casts (the red figure on the left), what it casts (a fire phoenix), who gets hit (the charging beasts) and what happens (they burn and die) can all be read from the frames. One minor issue: the shot is a wide shot, so the characters and beasts are small in frame and the beasts' exact species is hard to make out. That doesn't stop a viewer from following what happens.
